name: How long does bathroom drywall repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom drywall repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of bathroom drywall repair depends on the extent of the damage. Small patches might take a few hours of active work, spread over a day or two to allow for drying and sanding. Larger sections requiring full panel replacement, mudding, taping, and multiple coats of compound can take several days to a week. This timeline includes drying times between coats and the final prep for painting, which are critical for a lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; small patches take a few hours over 1-2 days, while larger replacements can take several days to a week due to drying times.
